issue.title: Flaky: test_agents_slow_tool_calls_fold_levels_png_snapshots fails only under full parallel suite
issue.description:
Discovered while verifying the sase-cu fix (unrelated flaky clipboard-modal test). Ran 'just test' three times in a row on an otherwise clean workspace to confirm the sase-cu fix held under xdist contention. On one of the three runs, this PNG visual-snapshot test failed:

  tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_agents_slow_tools.py::test_agents_slow_tool_calls_fold_levels_png_snapshots

It did not fail on the other two full-suite runs, and was not re-verified in isolation before filing (out of scope for sase-cu, which is specifically about the artifact-file clipboard-copy modal test). Given the visual snapshot suite's known sensitivity to renderer/font timing and CPU contention (see just/CLAUDE.md notes on `.pytest_cache/sase-visual/` artifacts and the CI ratio-only drift tolerance), this may be resource-contention-driven rendering nondeterminism under xdist rather than a real regression — worth someone re-running the dedicated visual suite (`just test-visual`) under load and inspecting `.pytest_cache/sase-visual/` actual/expected/diff artifacts to confirm before concluding it's a timing flake vs. a real snapshot drift.
